LanguageData.RT_BMP3_Vehicle.label: BMP-3 IFV
LanguageData.RT_BMP3_Vehicle.description:
Infantry fighting vehicle armed with a 100mm 2A70 gun and coaxial 30mm 2A72 autocannon. Upgradable to 2S38 57mm turret.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x2, Passenger x5 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 100mm 2A70 Cannon: 3UOF19 (HE), 9M117M (HEAT) [ATGM] - 30mm 2A72 Autocannon: 30x173mm cartridge (FMJ / HE / AP-I) - 7.62mm PKT MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP) - (Upgrade 2S38 Turret): 57x348mmSR (AP / AP-HE / Sabot)
